voice._name: Callum (ElevenLabs premade), eleven_v3 with audio tags in "say"

phrases.text: For thirty-three years, no one could touch Bobby Fischer's record.
phrases.say: [serious] For thirty-three years... no one could touch Bobby Fischer's record.

phrases.text: Then it started to fall. And right now, an eleven-year-old is coming for it.
phrases.say: Then it started to fall. And right now... an eleven-year-old is coming for it.

phrases.text: 1958. Fischer becomes a grandmaster at fifteen, the youngest in history.
phrases.say: Nineteen fifty-eight. Fischer becomes a grandmaster at fifteen. The youngest in history.

phrases.text: 1991. Judit Polgar breaks it, at fifteen years and four months.
phrases.say: Nineteen ninety-one. Judit Polgar breaks it... at fifteen years and four months.

phrases.text: Then Leko. Ponomariov. Bu Xiangzhi. Every few years, someone younger.
phrases.say: Then Leko. Ponomariov. Bu Shyang-jee. Every few years... someone younger.

phrases.text: 2002. Sergey Karjakin, twelve years and seven months. That record stood for nineteen years.
phrases.say: Two thousand two. Sergey Karjakin. Twelve years and seven months. [serious] That record stood for nineteen years.

phrases.text: In 2019, an Indian boy missed it by seventeen days. His name? Gukesh. At eighteen, he became world champion.
phrases.say: In twenty nineteen, an Indian boy missed it by seventeen days. His name? Gukesh. At eighteen... he became world champion.

phrases.text: 2021, Budapest. Abhimanyu Mishra, a kid from New Jersey. Twelve years, four months, twenty-five days. The youngest grandmaster ever.
phrases.say: Twenty twenty-one. Budapest. Abhimanyu Mishra, a kid from New Jersey. Twelve years, four months, twenty-five days. [excited] The youngest grandmaster ever.

phrases.text: This year, Argentina's Faustino Oro fell just two months short.
phrases.say: This year, Argentina's Faustino Oro fell just two months short.

phrases.text: And Roman Shogdzhiev, just eleven, already has two grandmaster norms. If he gets the title before February, he'll be the first grandmaster under twelve. The record could fall again.
phrases.say: And Roman Shog-jee-yev, just eleven, already has two grandmaster norms. If he gets the title before February... he'll be the first grandmaster under twelve. [whispers] The record could fall again.

phrases.text: How old were you when you learned chess? Comment below.
phrases.say: How old were you when you learned chess? Comment below.
